connectors.name: 2x7 expansion header (top edge)
connectors.orderNote: No printed pin numbers; horizontal 2x7 header, started at the left end (closest to the USB-C connector on the left side); position 1 in the outer (top, board-edge) row, then alternating rows

connectors.name: 4-pin port (right edge)
connectors.orderNote: No pin 1 mark; vertical row, started at the end closest to the USB-C connector. The USB-C is on the opposite (left) side, slightly lower than this port, so the lower G1 end is nearest

uncertain: top-header: the image is an illustrated diagram; the 2x7 label table is drawn at the header location but it is not certain the table cells correspond one-to-one with physical holes in this row/column arrangement.
notes: Cardputer-Adv illustrated pin map. 2x7 header labels: top row G3 G4 G6 G40 G14 G39 G5; bottom row 5V IN, GND, 5V OUT, G8 SDA, G9 SCL, G13, G15. Right port printed GND, *5V, G2, G1 (asterisk printed on 5V, label copied as printed; no footnote for it is visible). 3.5mm headphone jack (GND, OUT_LR, HP_DET), USB-C (D-:G19, D+:G20), and internal peripheral assignments (ES8311, BMI270, TCA8418, LCD) are not physical wiring points and were skipped.
